Un día cualquiera, caminando desde la ciudad hasta el bosque, atrajo rápidamente a un grupo de curiosos de los barrios pobres. Fue de uno en uno y, con remedios sencillos, hizo que mejoraran casi todas las personas enfermas. Su naturaleza empática no tiene parangón, y puede hacer que cualquiera se sienta cómodo en su compañía.
aliases.english_source: Not much is known about Antonio, beside him being an extremely talented doctor. How he gained the knowledge he possesses or the skills that he exhibits are a mystery. Wandering into town from the forest on a day like any other, he quickly attracted a crowd of curious people in the poor quarters. He went from person to person and, with simple remedies, made almost every sick person better. His sympathetic nature is unmatched and he can make any person feel welcome in his company.
aliases.translation: 人们对安东尼奥知之甚少，只知道他是一位天赋异禀的医生。他如何获得这些知识、练就这些本领，至今仍是谜。有一天，他像往常一样从森林走进镇子，很快便吸引了贫民区一群好奇的人。他挨家挨户地走访，用简单的药物治好了几乎每一位病人。他富有同情心，无人能及；无论是谁，都能在他身边感到自在。

aliases.source: Nacida en la servidumbre de tu familia, Sierra comenzó su formación como escudera. Desarrolló rápidamente una afición por el combate y pudiste comprobar sus habilidades. Se unió a tu hermandad a sugerencia tuya como soldado a tiempo completo, y ha estado entrenando durante los últimos años antes de que salieras de expedición.
aliases.english_source: Born in servitude to your family, Sierra started her training as a squire. She developed a taste for combat very quickly and her skills became apparent to you. At your suggestion she joined your hermandad as a full-time soldier, and has been training there for the past several years before you went on your expedition.
aliases.translation: 谢拉生来便是你家中的仆役，后来开始接受侍从训练。她很快便爱上了战斗，你也逐渐发现了她的本领。在你的建议下，她加入兄弟会成为一名全职士兵；在你启程远征之前，她已在那里训练了好几年。

aliases.source: Nacido en una familia de agitadores y pendencieros, Alberto no era diferente. Solía meterse en problemas de niño y le quedaron bastantes cicatrices que lo demuestran. Antes de unirse a tu hermandad, trabajó como tabernero en un establecimiento de dudosa reputación, donde puso en práctica sus dotes de lucha. Al final se cansó del hedor y se unió a ti, en busca de aire fresco y enemigos nuevos.
aliases.english_source: Born into a family of brawlers and troublemakers, Alberto was no different. He frequently ran into trouble as a child and got his fair share of scars to prove it. Before joining your hermandad, he worked as a barkeep in a less-than-reputable establishment, where his skills in fighting were put to good use. He eventually tired of the stink and joined you, in hopes of fresh air and fresh enemies.
aliases.translation: 阿尔贝托出生于一个好斗惹事的家庭，他也不例外。孩提时他常惹上麻烦，身上的伤疤就是明证。加入兄弟会之前，他在一家名声不佳的酒馆当酒保，打架的本领在那里派上了用场。最终，他厌倦了那里的臭气，便加入了你，希望呼吸新鲜空气，也找些新敌人。

aliases.source: Nació callejera sin padres conocidos, por lo que pasó su infancia robando para sobrevivir. En un día especialmente soleado se tropezó con tu padre, quien se apiadó de la niña. Su valentía y tenaz voluntad de vivir la convirtieron en una excelente candidata para tu ejército, donde ha pasado los últimos siete años esperando una oportunidad para compensar mediante el servicio la deuda que contrajo con tu padre.
aliases.english_source: Born as a street urchin to unknown parents, she spent her childhood stealing to survive. On a particularly sunny day she ran into your father, who took pity on the small child. Her fearlessness and tenacious will to live made her a prime candidate for your army, in which she has now spent the last seven years waiting for a chance to repay her debt to your father through service.
aliases.translation: 她是个弃儿，父母不详，从小靠偷窃活了下来。一个格外晴朗的日子，她遇见了你的父亲；他怜悯这个瘦小的孩子。她无所畏惧、求生意志顽强，因此成了你军中的理想人选。如今她已在军中效力七年，一直等待机会通过服役报答你父亲的恩情。

aliases.source: Nacida en 1493, es una pariente lejana de la familia de tu madre. Se hizo famosa cuando dio caza a un grupo de bandidos locales cerca de su casa y se deshizo de ellos ella sola. Su hazaña fue más bien suerte que talento, pero, gracias al entrenamiento con tu hermandad, se ha convertido en una guerrera notable y talentosa.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1493 and a distant relative on your mother's side. She became noticed for hunting down a group of local bandits near her home and singlehandedly disposing of them. Her feat was more through blind luck than talent, but through training with your hermandad, she became a skilled and remarkable fighter.
aliases.translation: 她生于1493年，是你母亲那边的远亲。她曾在家乡附近追踪一伙当地匪徒，并独自将他们全部除掉，因此声名鹊起。此举与其说是本领高强，不如说是运气使然；但经过在兄弟会的训练，她成长为一名技艺娴熟、表现出众的战士。

aliases.source: No se sabe mucho de Juan Ortega. A pesar de su crueldad en el campo de batalla, es una persona educada y de buenas palabras la mayor parte del tiempo, aunque es reservado y no habla de su pasado. Se ha establecido que trabajó como mercenario durante unos años antes de viajar a La Española, donde se unió a tu expedición, pero nadie sabe de dónde es o por qué decidió venir al Nuevo Mundo. Cada día que pasa, los rumores relativos al "maestro" Ortega cada vez son más impresionantes.
aliases.english_source: Not much is known of Juan Ortega. Despite his ruthlessness on the field of battle, he is a polite and soft-spoken character most of the time, but he keeps to himself and doesn't speak of his past. It has been established that he served as a mercenary for a few years before travelling to Hispaniola where he joined your expedition, but nobody knows where he is from or why he chose to come to the New World. With every passing evening, the rumours concerning "Maestro" Ortega grow ever more impressive.
aliases.translation: 人们对胡安·奥尔特加知之甚少。尽管他在战场上冷酷无情，平日里却彬彬有礼、寡言温和，只是深居简出，从不谈及自己的过去。据说他曾当过几年雇佣兵，后来前往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛并加入你的远征队，但没人知道他来自何处，也不知道他为何选择来到新大陆。每过一个夜晚，关于“大师”奥尔特加的传闻就更加离奇。

aliases.source: La joven Rosalía es la hija de la mano derecha de tu padre. Desde que empezó a andar, se puso a entrenarse, pues su padre estaba decidido a honrar su nombre. La aprobación no vendría fácilmente, ya que su padre había preferido tener un varón, pero ella la consiguió. Su lealtad es incuestionable y, a pesar de su juventud, su habilidad con la espada es impecable.
aliases.english_source: Young Rosalía is the daughter to your father's most trusted sword-arm. From the time she could walk, she started her training, her father determined to honour his name. Because her father had wished for a son, approval did not come easy, but she attained it. Her loyalty is unquestionable and despite her youth, her swordsmanship is flawless.
aliases.translation: 年轻的罗萨莉娅是你父亲最信任的剑术高手之女。她刚学会走路便开始训练，父亲一心想让她光耀门楣。父亲曾盼望有个儿子，因此她很难得到认可；但她最终赢得了认可。她忠心耿耿，虽年纪尚轻，剑术却已炉火纯青。

aliases.source: Nacida en 1494 en una granja a las afueras de tus dominios, perdió a sus padres cuando unos caballeros bandidos asaltaron y destruyeron su hogar. Juró vengarse y se unió a tu hermandad como soldado para matar a aquellos que habían asesinado a sus padres. Finalmente obtuvo su venganza, tras lo cual adoptó una actitud mucho más relajada. Sus habilidades en combate no tienen rival y por ello decidió mantenerse a tu servicio.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1494 on a farm on the outskirts of your fiefdom, she lost her parents to robber knights, who raided and destroyed her childhood home. Vowing her revenge, she joined your hermandad as a soldier to kill those who murdered her parents. Her revenge was eventually achieved, after which she assumed a much more calm demeanor. Her skills in combat are almost unrivaled, which is the reason she chose to stay in your service.
aliases.translation: 她于1494年出生在你领地边缘的一座农场。劫掠的骑士袭击并摧毁了她儿时的家园，她的父母也因此丧命。她立誓复仇，加入兄弟会成为士兵，只为杀死那些害死父母的人。大仇得报后，她的性情平和了许多。她的战斗本领几乎无人能敌，因此选择继续为你效力。

aliases.source: Guillermo Pascual ya estaba experimentado en combate a la edad de 19 años, habiendo combatido en innumerables batallas y escaramuzas. Nacido al servicio de tu madre, su familia ha actuado como milicia personal para ella y su familia desde generaciones. Se unió a tu hermandad como sargento y ayudó a otros a entrenarse mientras pulía sus propias habilidades. Guillermo es obstinado y cruel, pero sería muy difícil encontrar a alguien mejor para traer al combate.
aliases.english_source: Guillermo Pascual was already experienced in combat at the age of 19, having fought in countless skirmishes and battles. Born into your mother's service, his family has acted as a personal militia to her family for generations. He joined your hermandad as a sergeant and helped train others while honing his own skills. Guillermo is stubborn and ruthless, yet you would be hard pressed to find a better man to bring into the fray.
aliases.translation: 吉列尔莫·帕斯夸尔19岁时便已身经百战，参加过无数次小规模冲突和战斗。他生于为你母亲效力的家族；他的家族世世代代都是你母亲家族的民兵。他以中士身份加入兄弟会，一边磨练自身本领，一边协助训练他人。吉列尔莫固执而冷酷无情，但要找到比他更适合上阵杀敌的人，可不容易。

aliases.source: Nacido en 1485 y pariente lejano de tu madre; un hidalgo de pleno derecho. Lo convencieron para unirse a tu hermandad a los 19 años. Esperaban que el tiempo que pasara contigo le enseñaría algunas lecciones de humildad, pero pronto se hizo evidente que su genio era incontrolable. En combate, no obstante, su temperamento se canaliza y se concentra, convirtiéndolo en un activo inestimable.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1485 and a distant relative on your mother's side, a Hidalgo in his own right, he was persuaded to join your hermandad at the age of 19. It was hoped that his time with you would teach him some lessons in humility, but it quickly became apparent that his temper was uncontrollable. In combat, however, his temper is channeled and focused, making him an invaluable asset.
aliases.translation: 他生于1485年，是你母亲一方的远亲，也是颇有身份的伊达尔戈。19岁时，他受人劝说加入了你的兄弟会。人们希望在你身边的这段日子能教会他谦逊一些，但很快大家就发现，他的脾气根本无法控制。然而在战斗中，他能将怒火引导并集中起来，成为不可多得的助力。

aliases.source: De padre herrero, nació en 1494 en Madrid, donde empezó desde muy joven su vida como aprendiz. A los 15 años comenzó su entrenamiento como soldado bajo tu estandarte. Mostró una ferocidad y un entusiasmo que lo hacían destacar sobre los demás, y demostró su valía como soldado de tu hermandad.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1494 to a blacksmith in Madrid, where at a young age he began his life as an apprentice. At the age of 15 he began his training as a soldier under your banner. He showed a ferocity and zeal that made him stand out from the others and proved his worth as a soldier of your hermandad.
aliases.translation: 他于1494年出生在马德里的一户铁匠之家，很小便开始当学徒。15岁时，他在你的旗帜下开始接受士兵训练。他表现出的凶悍与热忱令他脱颖而出，也证明了自己是兄弟会里一名合格的士兵。

aliases.source: El padre de Blanca la envío a un convento siendo niña, ya que su familia no habría podido permitirse casarla. Las monjas le proporcionaron una infancia dura pero estimulante con un sistema educativo notablemente amplio y académico, lo que inculcó en ella el amor por el conocimiento y la búsqueda intelectual. Cuando cumplió la mayoría de edad, Blanca se unió a una misión a La Española donde ayudó a establecer una nueva capilla en la costa norte. Cuando surgió la oportunidad, te siguió sin pensarlo hacia tierra firme para traer la palabra de Dios a los nativos.
aliases.english_source: Blanca's father gave her to a nunnery at a young age, as her family could not afford to get her married. The nuns provided a harsh but stimulating childhood with a remarkably broad and scholarly educational regimen which instilled in her a love of knowledge and intellectual pursuit. When she came of age, Blanca joined a mission to Hispaniola where she helped to establish a new church on the north coast. When the opportunity arose, she jumped at the chance to follow you to the mainland and bring the word of God to the natives.
aliases.translation: 布兰卡年幼时，父亲便把她送进了修道院，因为家里负担不起她的嫁妆。修女们给了她严苛却充实的童年，安排的教育课程涉猎广泛、学术气息浓厚，令她由此热爱知识与求知。成年后，布兰卡加入了一支前往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的传教队伍，并协助在北海岸建立了一座新教堂。后来有机会跟随你前往美洲大陆、向原住民传播天主圣言时，她立刻抓住了这个机会。

aliases.source: Daniel Reyes creció en una familia de soldados, y estaba decidido a superar la tradición familiar. Aunque su padre lo introdujo en la carrera militar, él decidió estudiar estrategia y tácticas de batalla y, a base de duro trabajo y perseverancia, se ganó un puesto respetable como consejero de guerra de un marqués. Pero Reyes posee una mente inquieta y, cuando los rumores sobre el Nuevo Mundo llegaron a sus oídos, de oscuros cultos y rituales paganos, se propuso llegar a esas misteriosas costas. Si allí había magia antigua y conocimientos olvidados, tenían que ser para él.
aliases.english_source: Daniel Reyes grew up in a family of soldiers, and he was determined to ascend from the family tradition. Though his father set him on the path of a military career, he chose to study strategy and battle tactics, and through hard work and stubbornness he earned a respectable place as a war advisor to a Marquis. But Reyes is in possession of an ever travelling mind, and when rumours from the New World reached his ears, speaking of dark cults and heathen rituals, he set his sights on those mysterious new shores. If there was ancient magic and forbidden knowledge there, it would be his.
aliases.translation: 丹尼尔·雷耶斯出身士兵世家，却决心跳出家族传统。尽管父亲为他铺下了从军之路，他却选择钻研战略与战斗战术，凭借勤奋和固执，赢得了侯爵麾下一名受人尊敬的军事顾问之职。但雷耶斯的心思总在远方；新大陆有关黑暗邪教与异教仪式的传闻传入他耳中后，他便将目光投向那片神秘的新海岸。若那里真有古老魔法与禁忌知识，它们终将归他所有。

aliases.source: El padre de Julio murió defendiendo a su madre mientras daba a luz. Sus padres viajaban a tu ciudad cuando fueron atacados por bandidos. Su madre escapó, herida y rompiendo aguas. Se desmayó y murió cerca de las puertas de la ciudad, pero afortunadamente una joven pareja rescató a Julio del vientre de su madre moribunda y lo criaron como si fuera su propio hijo. Su padre adoptivo era el bibliotecario de tu padre, por lo que Julio creció rodeado de libros y panfletos. En ese entorno no era de extrañar que se interesase por las ciencias. A pesar de ello, tenía inquietudes que lo llevaron a buscar aventuras.
aliases.english_source: Julio's father was killed defending his birthing mother. His parents had been travelling to your town when they were attacked by bandits. His mother escaped, wounded and breaking water. She collapsed and died close to the city gates, but luckily a young couple rescued Julio from his dying mother's womb and raised the child as their own. Because his adoptive father was the keeper of your father's library, Julio grew up surrounded by books and pamphlets alike. It was natural for him to turn to the sciences in that environment. Yet something stirred in him, driving him to seek adventure.
aliases.translation: 胡里奥的父亲为保护临盆的母亲而丧命。当时父母正前往你的城镇，途中遭遇强盗袭击。母亲带伤逃脱，羊水也已破裂。她倒在城门附近，最终不幸身亡；所幸一对年轻夫妇从她弥留之际的腹中救出了胡里奥，并把他当作亲生孩子抚养。养父是你父亲图书馆的看守，因此胡里奥从小便被书籍和小册子包围。在那样的环境里，他自然而然地投身科学。可他心中仍有某种东西在涌动，驱使他去寻求冒险。

aliases.source: Mercedes nació en 1496 de padres desconocidos. La encontraron a la puerta de un convento, donde fue adoptada y criada. Al crecer, demostró un carácter imposible para las monjas, pues prefería campos de estudio que desafiaban la fe. Temerosa de ser calificada de bruja, huyó cuando tenía 13 años y vivió una vida retirada antes de unirse a tu expedición. Sus conocimientos sobre mitología no tienen rival, lo que la convierte en un activo inestimable a la hora de enfrentarte a un mundo con una rica mitología propia.
aliases.english_source: Mercedes was born in 1496 to unknown parents. She was found on the steps at a convent where she was taken in and cared for. Growing up, she proved extremely difficult for the nuns, preferring to study fields that challenged their faith. In fear of being branded a witch, she ran away at age 13 and lived a secluded life up until joining your expedition. Her insights into mythology are unrivaled, and facing a world with a rich mythology in its own right, she is an invaluable asset.
aliases.translation: 梅赛德斯于1496年出生，亲生父母不详。她在修道院的台阶上被人发现，后来被收留照料。长大后，她让修女们头疼不已，因为她偏爱研究那些挑战她们信仰的领域。她害怕被打成女巫，13岁时便逃了出去，此后一直过着隐居生活，直到加入你的远征队。她对神话的见解无人能及；面对这个本身就拥有丰富神话的世界，她是不可多得的助力。

aliases.source: Zárraga es un cazador de conocimiento con una actitud implacable. No hay libros o pergaminos que se le resistan, y cualquiera que intente ocultárselos es difamado y arrastrado al borde de la bancarrota. El fin siempre justifica los medios para Carlos Zárraga, y no hay duda de que descubrirá el saber y los secretos del Nuevo Mundo, aunque eso signifique torturar a cada alma que encuentre.
aliases.english_source: Zárraga is a hunter of knowledge, ruthless in his approach. No books or scrolls are unavailable to him, as any who tries to keep them from him is dragged through defamation to the verge of bankruptcy. The means always justify the end for Carlos Zárraga, and the lore and secrets of the new world WILL be revealed to him, even if it means torturing every soul he finds.
aliases.translation: 萨拉加是个追逐知识的猎人，手段冷酷。没有书籍或卷轴能逃过他的手掌心：凡是试图阻拦他的人，都会遭他诽谤中伤，直至濒临破产。对卡洛斯·萨拉加而言，结果总能证明手段正当；新大陆的传说与秘密终将被他揭开，哪怕这意味着要折磨他遇到的每一个人。

aliases.source: Bella Bonita era la hija de un cazador leal al rey. Su irresistible encanto y su increíble belleza la convirtieron en la doncella más atractiva de la corte, hasta el punto de que su padre tuviera que contratar guardias para alejar a los pretendientes. No obstante, lo que muchas mujeres matarían por tener era una maldición para Bonita, ya que deseaba ser respetada y admirada por sus logros más que por su aspecto. Este deseo la llevó finalmente a escapar y unirse a tu expedición.
aliases.english_source: Beautiful Bonita was the daughter of a royal huntsman to the King. Her radiant charms and her incredible beauty made her the most attractive maiden in the court, to the extent that her father was forced to hire guards to keep the suitors away. What most women would kill to have was a curse to Bonita, however, as she longed to be respected and admired for her achievements rather than her looks. This desire finally drove her to run away and join your expedition.
aliases.translation: 美丽的博妮塔是国王麾下一名王室猎官的女儿。她光彩照人的魅力与惊人美貌使她成为宫廷中最迷人的少女，以至于父亲不得不雇卫兵赶走求婚者。然而，别的女人梦寐以求的一切，对博妮塔而言却是诅咒：她渴望凭借自己的成就获得尊重与赞赏，而非美貌。最终，这份渴望促使她离家出走，加入你的远征队。

aliases.source: Aparte de su año de nacimiento, 1493, no se sabe mucho acerca del pasado de Raúl Carrillo. Durante años fue un hombre perseguido, acusado de caza furtiva y otras actividades inapropiadas. Se desconoce cómo consiguió escapar de la justicia durante tanto tiempo, pero su libertada continuada es un testamento de su talento. Es malhumorado e irritable, pero en la selva su paciencia no conoce límites. Puede permanecer quieto durante horas, listo para atacar en un abrir y cerrar de ojos.
aliases.english_source: Besides the year of his birth, not much is known about the past of Raúl Carrillo. For years, he was a wanted man, accused of poaching and other inappropriate activities. How he managed to escape the law for so long is unknown, but his continued freedom is a testament to his talents. He is ill-tempered and quick to anger, but in the jungles his patience knows no bounds. For hours on end he can be still, ready to pounce at the blink of an eye.
aliases.translation: 除了出生年份，人们对劳尔·卡里略的过去知之甚少。多年来他一直是通缉犯，被指控偷猎及从事其他不法勾当。他如何能长期逃脱法律制裁，无人知晓；但他至今仍逍遥法外，足以证明他的本事。他脾气暴躁，动辄发怒，可在丛林里却耐心无穷。几个小时一动不动地潜伏对他而言不在话下，只等眨眼间扑向猎物。

aliases.source: Nacida en 1489, creció en la ciudad bajo el techo de un flechero. Su conocimiento sobre arcos rivaliza con los expertos, y su habilidad para manejarlos incluso lo supera, aunque también ha demostrado ser útil con un fusil. Entrenó con la guardia de la ciudad durante varios años, antes de superar finalmente a sus superiores, encargándose de sus funciones y enseñando a otros estudiantes. Aunque no es lo que se dice humilde, sigue siendo consciente de sus limitaciones y tiene una personalidad agradable en general, lo que la convierte en una gran compañera.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1489, she grew up in the city under the roof of a fletcher. Her knowledge of bows rivals any expert, and her ability to handle them exceeds even that, but she's proven to be equally handy with an arquebus. She trained with the city guard for several years, before eventually surpassing her superiors, taking over their duties in teaching her fellow students. Although not exactly humble, she is still well aware of her limitations and has an overall pleasant personality, making her a great companion.
aliases.translation: 她生于1489年，在一名制弓匠家中长大。她对弓的了解足以媲美任何专家，运用弓的本领更是有过之而无不及；不过，她使用火绳枪也同样得心应手。她曾在城镇卫队训练多年，后来逐渐超越上级，接过了教导同窗的职责。她虽算不上谦逊，却很清楚自己的局限，性格总体也十分讨喜，是个很好的伙伴。

aliases.source: Rafael vivía bien como cazador en España, hasta que lo estropeó todo. Una noche, cegado por celos irracionales y enloquecido por el alcohol, asesinó a su tierna esposa por la sospecha de adulterio. Fue arrestado y sometido a juicio por asesinato, declarado culpable y sentenciado a muerte. En el último momento, se le ofreció a Rafael la posibilidad del perdón si accedía a ser enviado al Nuevo Mundo y servir a la Corona Española en sus expediciones al continente.
aliases.english_source: Rafael had a good life as a hunter in Spain, until he messed it all up. Blind with baseless jealousy and drunk out of his mind, he murdered his loving wife one night on suspicion of adultery. He was caught and tried for murder, found guilty and sentenced to death. At the last possible moment, Rafael was offered a chance of pardon if he agreed to be sent to the New World and serve the Spanish Crown on expeditions to the mainland.
aliases.translation: 拉斐尔曾在西班牙过着不错的猎人生活，直到他亲手毁掉了一切。他被毫无根据的嫉妒冲昏头脑，又醉得不省人事，一夜之间竟因怀疑妻子通奸而杀死了深爱他的妻子。他被捕并以谋杀罪受审，最终被判有罪、处以死刑。在行刑前的最后关头，拉斐尔得到了一次赦免机会：只要他愿意被送往新大陆，为西班牙王室效力，参加前往美洲大陆的远征。

aliases.source: Alejandro era el hijo de un vizconde cuya casa cayó en desgracia y miseria cuando tuvo un roce con un cardenal y se convirtió en objetivo de la Inquisición. La naturaleza y el origen de la disputa que acabó con Pintado son turbios y misteriosos, y, si Alejandro sabe algo, no está dispuesto a contarlo. Se unió a tu hermandad con la esperanza de restaurar el honor a su nombre y hasta ahora le ha ido bastante bien.
aliases.english_source: Alejandro was the son of a Vizconde whose house fell into disgrace and destitution when he ran afoul of a cardinal and became a target of the Inquisition. The nature and origin of the dispute that felled Pintado are murky and mysterious, and if Alejandro knows anything, he isn't willing to share it. He joined your hermandad hoping to restore honour to his name, and so far he's been doing quite well.
aliases.translation: 亚历杭德罗是子爵之子。父亲得罪了一位红衣主教，成为宗教裁判所的目标后，家族便蒙羞落魄。导致平塔多家族衰败的争端究竟缘何而起、始于何处，至今仍扑朔迷离；即便亚历杭德罗知道些什么，他也不愿透露。他加入你的兄弟会，希望恢复家族名誉，迄今进展颇为顺利。

aliases.source: La vida no trató bien a Gabriela en sus primeros años de vida. Expulsada de su casa familiar para que se las arreglara ella sola a los 12 años, recurrió a la prostitución y a la mendicidad para poder comer. Después de que casi muriera tras un desesperado aborto improvisado, su suerte cambió finalmente cuando fue adoptada por un viejo leñador solitario que le enseñó a cazar y a curtir. Su sentido de la dignidad se restauró finalmente tras varios años llevando una vida respetable; se unió a la tripulación de un barco rumbo a La Española, donde la conociste como cazadora en los bosques al noreste de Santo Domingo.
aliases.english_source: Life was not good to Gabriela in the early years of her life. Thrown out of her family's house to fend for herself at the age of 12, she resorted to prostitution and begging to feed herself. After she nearly died following a desperate makeshift abortion, her luck finally changed when she was taken in by a lonely old woodsman who taught her hunting and tanning. Her sense of self-worth finally restored after several years of maintaining a respectable living, she joined the crew of a ship to Hispaniola, where you met her as a hunter in the forests northeast of Santo Domingo.
aliases.translation: 加夫列拉早年的生活并不顺遂。12岁时，她被家人赶出家门，只能独自谋生，于是靠卖淫和乞讨糊口。一次走投无路的土法堕胎几乎要了她的命；此后她的运气终于有所好转，一位孤独的老樵夫收留了她，并教她狩猎与制革。几年间，她靠正当营生重拾自尊，随后成为一艘开往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的船只上的船员。你是在圣多明各东北方的森林里遇见她的，当时她正是一名猎人。

aliases.source: Desde que era un niño, Montego siempre tuvo un fuerte sentido del deber cívico y un poderoso deseo de encontrar aventuras y ser un héroe, pero nunca fue muy bueno en el combate ni le gustaba matar a gente. Cuando se unió a tu hermandad, se encargó del estudio de los mapas y la orientación, y rápidamente se convirtió en el mejor explorador de tu equipo. Sabes que, mientras Montego esté contigo, nunca te perderás.
aliases.english_source: Ever since he was a child, Montego always had a strong sense of civic duty and a powerful desire to find adventure and be a hero, but he was never very good at combat or very fond of killing people. When he joined your hermandad, he took up the study of maps and orienteering and quickly became the best scout in your brotherhood. As long as Montego is with you, you know that you will never get lost.
aliases.translation: 蒙特戈从小就有强烈的公共责任感，满心渴望冒险、成为英雄；可他既不擅长战斗，也不喜欢杀人。加入你的兄弟会后，他开始学习地图绘制与野外寻路，很快便成了兄弟会里最出色的斥候。只要蒙特戈跟着你，你就不用担心迷路。

aliases.source: Francisco es un joven bajo y delgado con rasgos delicados y un encanto pícaro. Aunque hacía poco que se había unido a tu hermandad cuando te embarcaste al Nuevo Mundo, estaba deseoso de unirse a tu expedición. Lo que le falta en fuerza, lo compensa en resistencia y agilidad, y sus trucos acrobáticos son especialmente populares por la tarde, alrededor de las hogueras.
aliases.english_source: Francisco is a short and slender young man with delicate features and a rogueish charm. Though he had only recently joined your hermandad by the time you left for the New World, he was eager to join your expedition. What he lacks in strength, he more than makes up for in endurance and agility, and his acrobatic tricks are particularly popular in the evening around the campfires.
aliases.translation: 弗朗西斯科是个身材矮小纤瘦的年轻人，五官秀气，带着几分浪荡子的魅力。你启程前往新大陆时，他才刚加入你的兄弟会，却已迫不及待想参加远征。他力量不足之处，耐力与敏捷足以弥补；尤其是在营火旁的夜晚，他表演的杂技总是大受欢迎。

aliases.source: Daniela, hija de un campesino, se casó con un rico mercader relativamente tarde, a los 15 años. La pareja viajó mucho, y Daniela aprendió rápidamente a sobrevivir en la carretera, en todo tipo de terrenos y climas. Su talento natural para orientarse ayudó mucho a su marido, y el negocio fue bien durante años. Cuando Daniela tenía veintitantos, sufrió una tragedia cuando su marido fue asesinado por un socio comercial y le robaron todas sus posesiones. Ahora una viuda indigente, a Daniela la encontró y la adoptó un miembro de tu hermandad, donde puso en práctica sus habilidades.
aliases.english_source: Daniela was a farmer's daughter who married a wealthy merchant relatively late, at the age of 15. The couple travelled a lot, and Daniela quickly learned how to survive on the road, in many types of terrain and weather. Her natural talent for path finding served her husband well, and for several years, business was good. When Daniela was in her mid-20s, tragedy struck as her husband was murdered by a business partner and robbed of all his possessions. Left a destitute widow, Daniela was found and taken in by a member of your hermandad, where she put her skills to good use.
aliases.translation: 丹妮埃拉是农夫的女儿，15岁时才嫁给一位富商，在当时已算相当晚婚。夫妻二人四处奔走，丹妮埃拉很快学会了如何在旅途中生存，适应各种地形与天气。她天生擅长辨路，令丈夫受益匪浅，生意也顺遂了好几年。丹妮埃拉二十多岁时遭逢变故：丈夫被生意伙伴杀害，财物也被洗劫一空。她沦为一贫如洗的寡妇，后来被你兄弟会的一名成员发现并收留，总算得以施展所长。

aliases.source: Nacida en 1498, Raina es una mujer estoica y profesional que se unió a tu hermandad muy joven esperando encontrar un sitio donde pudiera sentirse realizada. Prefiere la sutileza y la astucia antes que la fuerza y la confrontación, y posee una fuente aparentemente interminable de trucos y conocimientos de supervivencia.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1498, Raina is a stoic and professional-minded woman who joined your hermandad at an early age hoping to find a place where she could feel like she belonged. She prefers subtlety and cleverness over force and confrontation, and she possesses a seemingly endless font of tricks and knowledge of wilderness survival.
aliases.translation: 蕾娜生于1498年，是个沉着而严谨的女人。她很早便加入你的兄弟会，希望找到一个真正有归属感的地方。比起强攻和正面冲突，她更偏爱隐秘行动与机敏应对；她似乎有用不完的奇招，对野外生存也颇有心得。

aliases.source: Federico, la persona de más edad de tu expedición, tiene muchos años de experiencia activa como soldado, pero siempre ha sido demasiado insubordinado para avanzar más allá de un rango básico. Cuando se ofreció a unirse a tu expedición, sospechaste que las mismas cualidades que lo convertían en un mal soldado (su independencia y su completa falta de honor) harían de él un excelente explorador y, efectivamente, Federico ha demostrado desde entonces tener muchos recursos y ser eficiente en su nuevo rol.
aliases.english_source: The oldest person in your expedition, Federico has many years of active service experience as a soldier, but has always been too insubordinate to advance beyond a basic rank. When he offered to join your expedition, you suspected that the very qualities that made him a poor soldier - his independence and his utter lack of honour - would make him an excellent scout, and indeed Federico has since proven himself to be highly resourceful and effective in his new role.
aliases.translation: 费德里科是你这支远征队中年纪最大的人。他有多年现役士兵经验，却总因桀骜不驯而无法晋升到基础军阶以上。当他提出加入远征队时，你猜想，正是那些令他成为差劲士兵的特质——独立自主、毫无荣誉感——会让他成为出色的斥候。事实证明，你的判断没错：费德里科在新职位上既机灵又能干。

aliases.source: Feroz e independiente, Ana escogió el sobrenombre de "Pantera" al principio de la expedición frente a otros soldados. Cuando está de servicio, destaca por su habilidad para pasar desapercibida por cualquier terreno, como una sombra que no deja huella a su alrededor. No hace falta decir que esto la convierte en una excelente exploradora. Cuando no está de servicio, destaca por tener varios amantes y ni siquiera intentar ocultar su conducta. Naturalmente, esto levanta todo tipo de chismes, celos y desprecios entre las tropas, pero a Anita no parece que le importe en absoluto.
aliases.english_source: Fierce and independent Ana picked up the nickname "Pantera" among the troops early in the expedition. When on duty, she is remarkable for her ability to move unnoticed through any terrain, like a shadow that leaves no mark upon its surroundings. Needless to say, this makes her an excellent scout. Off duty, she is remarkable for having several lovers and not even attempting to conceal her conduct. Naturally, this gives rise to all sorts of gossipping, jealousy, and contempt among the troops, but Anita herself seems perfectly disinterested in all this.
aliases.translation: 安娜骁勇而独立，远征初期便在军中得了“黑豹”的绰号。执行任务时，她能在任何地形中悄无声息地穿行，仿佛一道不留痕迹的影子；毫无疑问，这使她成为一名出色的斥候。休息时，她有好几位情人，而且从不试图掩饰自己的风流行径。这自然引来军中各色流言、嫉妒与鄙夷，但安娜本人似乎对此毫不在意。

aliases.source: El mercenario húngaro es un hombre de complexión poderosa de aspecto especialmente imponente con su armadura negra a trozos. Fue entrenado en el Ejército Negro húngaro y luchó contra los turcos así como contra una revuelta campesina. Tras la disolución del Fekete sereg, su compañía fue a su aire y viajó a Italia para luchar como mercenario. Ahora ha venido al Nuevo Mundo para buscar a su viejo amigo, Tamás Szász.
aliases.english_source: The Hungarian mercenary is a powerfully built man who looks particularly imposing in his black piecemeal armour. He was trained in Hungary's Black Army and fought against the Turks as well as a peasant rebellion. After the dissolution of the Fekete sereg, his company struck out on their own and he travelled to Italy to fight as a mercenary. Now he has come to the New World searching for his old friend, Tamás Szász.
aliases.translation: 这名匈牙利雇佣兵身材魁梧，穿着一身黑色拼凑护甲，显得格外威风。他曾在匈牙利黑军受训，也曾与土耳其人作战，并镇压过一场农民叛乱。黑军解散后，他所在的佣兵队自立门户；他则前往意大利，以雇佣兵身份作战。如今，他来到新大陆，寻找旧友塔马什·萨斯。

aliases.source: Atl es el curandero de una pequeña aldea de pescadores en la costa norte de La Española. Posee un ingenio mordaz y sarcástico que le gusta poner en práctica siempre que le es posible. A pesar de sus reservas frente a los españoles, no puede evitar ayudar a cualquiera que lo necesite, independientemente de su etnia.
aliases.english_source: Atl is the healer of a small fishing village on the north coast of Hispaniola. He possesses a biting sarcastic wit which he likes to exercise whenever possible. Despite his reservations towards the Spanish, he is compelled to aid anyone in need, regardless of their ethnicity.
aliases.translation: 阿特尔是伊斯帕尼奥拉岛北海岸一座小渔村的治疗师。他言辞尖刻、颇具讽刺意味，而且总喜欢逮着机会挖苦人。尽管他对西班牙人心存戒备，却总是忍不住援助有需要的人，不论对方属于什么族群。

aliases.source: Esteban llegó a La Española con 23 años. Fue reclutado por el ejército y sirvió a disgusto durante dos años bajo las órdenes del capitán Noriega. Cuando se hartó, desertó y se las apañó en la jungla durante casi una década. Finalmente se unió a una banda de compañeros desertores liderados en secreto por Leandra Vizcaíno, aunque pronto tomó el mando de las tropas, ganándose así su lealtad. Temerosa de una lucha de poder, Leandra emboscó a sus soldados, empujando a Esteban a buscar una alianza con los salvajes caribes. Allí lo encontraste de nuevo, lo derrotaste por última vez y lo convenciste para que se uniera a ti.
aliases.english_source: Esteban came to Hispaniola at the age of 23. He was drafted into the army and served uneasily under Capitán Noriega for two years. When he was fed up, he deserted and lived by himself in the jungle for almost a decade. Eventually he joined a band of fellow deserters under the secret command of Leandra Vizcaino, but he soon took charge of the troops, and they became far more loyal to him. Fearing a power-struggle, Leandra ambushed his troops, driving Esteban to seek an alliance with the savage Caribs. There, you found him again, defeated him one last time, and convinced him to join you.
aliases.translation: 埃斯特班23岁时来到了伊斯帕尼奥拉岛。他被征召入伍，在诺列加上尉麾下服役了两年，日子并不好过。终于忍无可忍后，他当了逃兵，独自在丛林中生活了近十年。后来，他加入了一伙同样当过逃兵的人；这伙人暗中听命于莱安德拉·维斯卡伊诺。但不久后，他便接管了这支队伍，众人也对他忠心了许多。莱安德拉担心权力之争，于是伏击了他的部队，逼得埃斯特班转而寻求与野蛮的加勒比人结盟。你在那里再次找到他，最后一次击败了他，并说服他加入你的队伍。

aliases.source: Hija de Andrés de Yruenes, quien fue miembro de la tripulación de Colón. La madre de Isabela era una mujer taína y, como hija de dos mundos, a Isabela nunca le fácil para encajar. A pesar de sus dificultades para ganarse la confianza de la tribu de su madre y el tratamiento, a menudo terrible, que sufría de los colonos en Santo Domingo, Isabela se aferró obstinadamente a una actitud positiva ante la vida. Es lo opuesto a ingenua, ya que ha visto a menudo lo peor de las personas, pero es una mujer abierta y estoicamente educada que lucha por la paz y la reconciliación de sus dos pueblos.
aliases.english_source: The daughter of Andres de Yruenes, who was a part of Columbus' crew. Isabela's mother was a Taíno woman, and as a child of two worlds, Isabela has never found it easy to fit in. Despite her difficulties in gaining the trust of her mother's tribesmen, and the often terrible treatment she sustained from the colonists in Santo Domingo, Isabela has stubbornly held on to a positive outlook on life. She is far from naive, having seen many of the worst sides of people, but she is a stoically polite and open-minded woman who fights for peace and reconciliation for both her peoples.
aliases.translation: 哥伦布船员之一安德烈斯·德·尤鲁埃内斯之女。伊莎贝拉的母亲是一位泰诺人。作为两个世界的孩子，伊莎贝拉始终难以融入其中。尽管她难以取得母亲族人的信任，也常遭圣多明各殖民者恶劣对待，她仍顽强地保持着乐观的人生态度。她绝非天真无知，早已见识过人性最恶劣的一面；但她是一位沉着、礼貌、思想开放的女性，为两个族群的和平与和解而奋斗。

aliases.source: Nato nel 1469, trascorse un'infanzia relativamente serena in una piccola città agricola. Incontrò l'amore della sua vita, che sposò in giovane età. Durante il suo periodo di apprendistato come alchimista, sua moglie si ammalò di tifo e poco dopo morì. Questa perdita lo fece sprofondare in una cupa depressione, in seguito alla quale si isolò, dedicandosi anima e corpo al proprio lavoro e agli studi medici. Non si è mai ripreso completamente dal lutto che gli ha spezzato il cuore ed è anche per superare questo dolore che ha deciso di partecipare alla tua spedizione. È un uomo austero e silenzioso, ma nessuno possiede conoscenze più approfondite di lui nel campo delle malattie e delle infezioni.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1469, he had a relatively normal childhood, growing up in a small farm town. He met the love of his life, whom he married at a young age. He was apprenticing as an alchemist when his wife fell ill from typhus and died a short while later. The loss sent him into a deep depression and he buried himself in his work and the field of disease treatment. He never fully recovered from his broken heart, and partly the reason he joined your expedition was to get over his grief. A somber and quiet man, but no man knows better the field of diseases and infections than he.
aliases.translation: 他生于1469年，童年生活相当平凡，在一座小型农庄镇长大。他很早便与一生挚爱结了婚。当他还在做炼金术士学徒时，妻子染上斑疹伤寒，不久便去世了。这场失去让他陷入深深的抑郁；他把自己埋进工作中，专心钻研疾病治疗。他始终没能从心碎中完全恢复，而他加入你们的远征，部分原因也是想走出悲痛。他是个沉郁寡言的人，但论疾病与感染，无人比他更精通。

aliases.source: Nata nel 1487 in una famiglia di guaritori, da padre medico e madre erborista. Sin dall'infanzia manifestò un atteggiamento cinico e crudele, considerando il corpo umano mera carne che può essere riparata come una cosa qualsiasi. La freddezza e il cinismo che la caratterizzano sono sconcertanti, ma le sue competenze sono ineccepibili e senza pari.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1487 into a family of healers, her father a doctor and her mother a herbalist. Throughout her childhood she exhibited a cynical and brutal outlook, seeing the human body as nothing more than flesh which can be repaired like anything else. Her dispassion and cynicism are troubling, but her skills are flawless and unmatched.
aliases.translation: 1487年，她出生于一个医者世家，父亲是医生，母亲是草药师。童年时期，她便显露出愤世嫉俗、冷酷无情的一面，在她眼中，人体不过是一堆血肉，和其他东西一样可以修补。她的冷漠与愤世嫉俗令人不安，但她的医术无懈可击，无人能及。

aliases.source: La madre di Teresa morì nel darla alla luce e il padre sprofondò in una depressione da cui non si riprese più. Avendo visto tanta sofferenza attorno a sé da bambina, maturò la volontà di aiutare le persone a guarire. Prima di unirsi alla tua spedizione, era il medico locale della tua zona e si distingueva soprattutto per la sua abilità nel suturare le ferite.
aliases.english_source: Teresa's mother died when she was giving birth, launching her father into a deep depression from which he never recovered. Seeing suffering all around her as a child, she grew determined to help people get well. Before joining your expedition, she was the local doctor in your area, where she excelled particularly in stitching wounds.
aliases.translation: 特蕾莎的母亲在生下她时去世，父亲因此陷入深深的抑郁，再也没能振作起来。童年时目睹身边的人饱受苦难，她便下定决心帮助人们恢复健康。在加入你的远征队之前，她是你领地附近的医生，尤其擅长缝合伤口。

aliases.source: Non si sa molto di Antonio, oltre al fatto che è un medico eccezionale. Come abbia acquisito le conoscenze e le competenze che possiede, è un mistero. Un giorno come tanti altri, si avventurò in città dalla foresta e girando per i quartieri poveri attirò ben presto una folla di curiosi. Passando di persona in persona, con semplici rimedi diede sollievo a quasi tutti i malati. Dotato di un'umanità senza pari, è in grado di far sentire a suo agio chiunque gli stia accanto.
aliases.english_source: Not much is known about Antonio, beside him being an extremely talented doctor. How he gained the knowledge he possesses or the skills that he exhibits are a mystery. Wandering into town from the forest on a day like any other, he quickly attracted a crowd of curious people in the poor quarters. He went from person to person and, with simple remedies, made almost every sick person better. His sympathetic nature is unmatched and he can make any person feel welcome in his company.
aliases.translation: 人们对安东尼奥知之甚少，只知道他是一位天赋异禀的医生。他如何获得这些知识、练就这些本领，至今仍是谜。有一天，他像往常一样从森林走进镇子，很快便吸引了贫民区一群好奇的人。他挨家挨户地走访，用简单的药物治好了几乎每一位病人。他富有同情心，无人能及；无论是谁，都能在他身边感到自在。

aliases.source: Nata al servizio della tua famiglia, Sierra iniziò il proprio addestramento come scudiero. Sviluppò assai rapidamente una predilezione per il combattimento e notasti presto le sue capacità. Dietro tuo suggerimento, si arruolò nella tua compagnia come soldato a tempo pieno, addestrandosi duramente negli anni precedenti alla spedizione.
aliases.english_source: Born in servitude to your family, Sierra started her training as a squire. She developed a taste for combat very quickly and her skills became apparent to you. At your suggestion she joined your hermandad as a full-time soldier, and has been training there for the past several years before you went on your expedition.
aliases.translation: 谢拉生来便是你家中的仆役，后来开始接受侍从训练。她很快便爱上了战斗，你也逐渐发现了她的本领。在你的建议下，她加入兄弟会成为一名全职士兵；在你启程远征之前，她已在那里训练了好几年。

aliases.source: Nato da una famiglia di attaccabrighe e piantagrane, Alberto non era diverso dai suoi parenti. Da bambino spesso finiva nei guai, come testimoniano le sue numerose cicatrici. Prima di arruolarsi nella tua compagnia, gestiva una bettola malfamata, dove ebbe l'occasione di sfruttare al meglio le proprie abilità nel combattimento. Alla fine si stufò della propria squallida vita e decise di unirsi a te, nella speranza di cambiare aria e affrontare nuovi nemici.
aliases.english_source: Born into a family of brawlers and troublemakers, Alberto was no different. He frequently ran into trouble as a child and got his fair share of scars to prove it. Before joining your hermandad, he worked as a barkeep in a less-than-reputable establishment, where his skills in fighting were put to good use. He eventually tired of the stink and joined you, in hopes of fresh air and fresh enemies.
aliases.translation: 阿尔贝托出生于一个好斗惹事的家庭，他也不例外。孩提时他常惹上麻烦，身上的伤疤就是明证。加入兄弟会之前，他在一家名声不佳的酒馆当酒保，打架的本领在那里派上了用场。最终，他厌倦了那里的臭气，便加入了你，希望呼吸新鲜空气，也找些新敌人。

aliases.source: Ragazza di strada nata da genitori ignoti, trascorse la sua infanzia rubando per sopravvivere. Un giorno particolarmente fortunato la piccola si imbatté in tuo padre, che se ne impietosì. Il suo coraggio e il suo straordinario attaccamento alla vita ne fecero una candidata ideale per la tua compagnia, in cui ha trascorso gli ultimi sette anni aspettando l'occasione per ripagare con i propri servigi il debito verso tuo padre.
aliases.english_source: Born as a street urchin to unknown parents, she spent her childhood stealing to survive. On a particularly sunny day she ran into your father, who took pity on the small child. Her fearlessness and tenacious will to live made her a prime candidate for your army, in which she has now spent the last seven years waiting for a chance to repay her debt to your father through service.
aliases.translation: 她是个弃儿，父母不详，从小靠偷窃活了下来。一个格外晴朗的日子，她遇见了你的父亲；他怜悯这个瘦小的孩子。她无所畏惧、求生意志顽强，因此成了你军中的理想人选。如今她已在军中效力七年，一直等待机会通过服役报答你父亲的恩情。

aliases.source: Nata nel 1493 e tua lontana parente da parte di madre. Divenne nota per aver scovato ed eliminato con le sue sole forze un gruppo di banditi locali vicino a casa. Compì l'impresa più per fortuna che grazie alle sue effettive capacità, ma addestrandosi nella tua compagnia è diventata una guerriera esperta e temibile.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1493 and a distant relative on your mother's side. She became noticed for hunting down a group of local bandits near her home and singlehandedly disposing of them. Her feat was more through blind luck than talent, but through training with your hermandad, she became a skilled and remarkable fighter.
aliases.translation: 她生于1493年，是你母亲那边的远亲。她曾在家乡附近追踪一伙当地匪徒，并独自将他们全部除掉，因此声名鹊起。此举与其说是本领高强，不如说是运气使然；但经过在兄弟会的训练，她成长为一名技艺娴熟、表现出众的战士。

aliases.source: Non si sa molto di Juan Ortega. Spietato sul campo di battaglia, in realtà è un uomo gentile e pacato che preferisce la solitudine ed evita di parlare del suo passato. Nessuno sa da dove venga o perché abbia deciso di partire per il Nuovo Mondo, ma quel che è certo è che servì come mercenario per alcuni anni prima di raggiungere Hispaniola, dove si unì alla tua spedizione. Ogni giorno che passa, le voci che circolano sul "Maestro" Ortega diventano sempre più avvincenti.
aliases.english_source: Not much is known of Juan Ortega. Despite his ruthlessness on the field of battle, he is a polite and soft-spoken character most of the time, but he keeps to himself and doesn't speak of his past. It has been established that he served as a mercenary for a few years before travelling to Hispaniola where he joined your expedition, but nobody knows where he is from or why he chose to come to the New World. With every passing evening, the rumours concerning "Maestro" Ortega grow ever more impressive.
aliases.translation: 人们对胡安·奥尔特加知之甚少。尽管他在战场上冷酷无情，平日里却彬彬有礼、寡言温和，只是深居简出，从不谈及自己的过去。据说他曾当过几年雇佣兵，后来前往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛并加入你的远征队，但没人知道他来自何处，也不知道他为何选择来到新大陆。每过一个夜晚，关于“大师”奥尔特加的传闻就更加离奇。

aliases.source: La giovane Rosalía è la figlia dello spadaccino più fidato di tuo padre. Il suo addestramento iniziò non appena fu in grado di camminare, poiché il padre era determinato a mantenere alto il proprio nome. Dato che il padre avrebbe voluto un figlio maschio, per lei fu difficile ottenere il suo sostegno, ma alla fine ci riuscì. La sua lealtà è indiscutibile e, nonostante la giovane età, la sua abilità con la spada è impeccabile.
aliases.english_source: Young Rosalía is the daughter to your father's most trusted sword-arm. From the time she could walk, she started her training, her father determined to honour his name. Because her father had wished for a son, approval did not come easy, but she attained it. Her loyalty is unquestionable and despite her youth, her swordsmanship is flawless.
aliases.translation: 年轻的罗萨莉娅是你父亲最信任的剑术高手之女。她刚学会走路便开始训练，父亲一心想让她光耀门楣。父亲曾盼望有个儿子，因此她很难得到认可；但她最终赢得了认可。她忠心耿耿，虽年纪尚轻，剑术却已炉火纯青。

aliases.source: Nata nel 1494 in una fattoria alla periferia del tuo feudo, perse i genitori per mano di cavalieri predoni che saccheggiarono e distrussero la sua casa. Giurò vendetta e si arruolò nella tua compagnia per uccidere gli assassini dei genitori. Una volta ottenuta soddisfazione, assunse un atteggiamento molto più pacato. Le sue abilità nel combattimento sono quasi senza eguali e questo è il motivo per cui ha scelto di rimanere al tuo servizio.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1494 on a farm on the outskirts of your fiefdom, she lost her parents to robber knights, who raided and destroyed her childhood home. Vowing her revenge, she joined your hermandad as a soldier to kill those who murdered her parents. Her revenge was eventually achieved, after which she assumed a much more calm demeanor. Her skills in combat are almost unrivaled, which is the reason she chose to stay in your service.
aliases.translation: 她于1494年出生在你领地边缘的一座农场。劫掠的骑士袭击并摧毁了她儿时的家园，她的父母也因此丧命。她立誓复仇，加入兄弟会成为士兵，只为杀死那些害死父母的人。大仇得报后，她的性情平和了许多。她的战斗本领几乎无人能敌，因此选择继续为你效力。

aliases.source: All'età di diciannove anni, Guillermo Pascual aveva già una grande esperienza nel combattimento, avendo affrontato innumerevoli duelli e battaglie. Nacque al servizio di tua madre, in una famiglia che da generazioni offriva alla sua i propri servigi come milizia personale. Entrò a far parte della tua compagnia con il ruolo di sergente e aiutò ad addestrare altri soldati, continuando nello stesso tempo a perfezionare la propria tecnica. Guillermo è caparbio e spietato, eppure ti sarebbe estremamente difficile trovare un uomo migliore con cui combattere fianco a fianco.
aliases.english_source: Guillermo Pascual was already experienced in combat at the age of 19, having fought in countless skirmishes and battles. Born into your mother's service, his family has acted as a personal militia to her family for generations. He joined your hermandad as a sergeant and helped train others while honing his own skills. Guillermo is stubborn and ruthless, yet you would be hard pressed to find a better man to bring into the fray.
aliases.translation: 吉列尔莫·帕斯夸尔19岁时便已身经百战，参加过无数次小规模冲突和战斗。他生于为你母亲效力的家族；他的家族世世代代都是你母亲家族的民兵。他以中士身份加入兄弟会，一边磨练自身本领，一边协助训练他人。吉列尔莫固执而冷酷无情，但要找到比他更适合上阵杀敌的人，可不容易。

aliases.source: Nato nel 1485 e tuo lontano parente da parte di madre, un vero hidalgo, fu convinto ad arruolarsi nella tua compagnia all'età di diciannove anni. Si sperava che durante il periodo trascorso al tuo fianco avrebbe potuto imparare un po' di umiltà, ma ben presto fu chiaro che la sua indole era irrefrenabile. In combattimento, tuttavia, è in grado di incanalare e concentrare la propria rabbia e per questo rappresenta una risorsa estremamente preziosa.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1485 and a distant relative on your mother's side, a Hidalgo in his own right, he was persuaded to join your hermandad at the age of 19. It was hoped that his time with you would teach him some lessons in humility, but it quickly became apparent that his temper was uncontrollable. In combat, however, his temper is channeled and focused, making him an invaluable asset.
aliases.translation: 他生于1485年，是你母亲一方的远亲，也是颇有身份的伊达尔戈。19岁时，他受人劝说加入了你的兄弟会。人们希望在你身边的这段日子能教会他谦逊一些，但很快大家就发现，他的脾气根本无法控制。然而在战斗中，他能将怒火引导并集中起来，成为不可多得的助力。

aliases.source: Nato nel 1494, suo padre lavorava come maniscalco a Madrid dove, sin da bambino, iniziò l'apprendistato. A quindici anni cominciò ad addestrarsi come soldato sotto il tuo vessillo. Mostrava una ferocia e uno zelo che lo distinguevano da tutti gli altri ed erano la riprova del suo valore come soldato per la tua compagnia.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1494 to a blacksmith in Madrid, where at a young age he began his life as an apprentice. At the age of 15 he began his training as a soldier under your banner. He showed a ferocity and zeal that made him stand out from the others and proved his worth as a soldier of your hermandad.
aliases.translation: 他于1494年出生在马德里的一户铁匠之家，很小便开始当学徒。15岁时，他在你的旗帜下开始接受士兵训练。他表现出的凶悍与热忱令他脱颖而出，也证明了自己是兄弟会里一名合格的士兵。

aliases.source: Quando Blanca era bambina, suo padre la affidò a un convento, poiché la sua famiglia non era in grado di garantirle una dote. La sua infanzia con le suore fu dura ma stimolante, poiché ella ricevette un'educazione ricca e approfondita che instillò in lei l'amore per la conoscenza e l'attività intellettuale. Una volta raggiunta l'età adulta, Blanca si unì a una missione a Hispaniola, dove aiutò a fondare una nuova chiesa sulla costa settentrionale. Quando se ne presentò l'occasione, non si fece sfuggire l'opportunità di seguirti sul continente per portare la parola di Dio ai nativi.
aliases.english_source: Blanca's father gave her to a nunnery at a young age, as her family could not afford to get her married. The nuns provided a harsh but stimulating childhood with a remarkably broad and scholarly educational regimen which instilled in her a love of knowledge and intellectual pursuit. When she came of age, Blanca joined a mission to Hispaniola where she helped to establish a new church on the north coast. When the opportunity arose, she jumped at the chance to follow you to the mainland and bring the word of God to the natives.
aliases.translation: 布兰卡年幼时，父亲便把她送进了修道院，因为家里负担不起她的嫁妆。修女们给了她严苛却充实的童年，安排的教育课程涉猎广泛、学术气息浓厚，令她由此热爱知识与求知。成年后，布兰卡加入了一支前往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的传教队伍，并协助在北海岸建立了一座新教堂。后来有机会跟随你前往美洲大陆、向原住民传播天主圣言时，她立刻抓住了这个机会。

aliases.source: Daniel Reyes crebbe in una famiglia di guerrieri ed era determinato a portare avanti la tradizione di famiglia. Sebbene suo padre l'avesse indirizzato alla carriera militare, scelse di studiare strategia e tattiche di battaglia e, grazie al duro lavoro e alla sua ostinazione, riuscì a guadagnarsi una posizione prestigiosa come consigliere presso un marchese. Ma Reyes è dotato di una mente in perenne movimento e quando gli giunsero dal Nuovo Mondo voci di culti oscuri e barbari rituali, crebbe in lui l'interesse verso quelle misteriose terre inesplorate. Se laggiù dimoravano magia antica e conoscenze proibite, lui se ne sarebbe impossessato.
aliases.english_source: Daniel Reyes grew up in a family of soldiers, and he was determined to ascend from the family tradition. Though his father set him on the path of a military career, he chose to study strategy and battle tactics, and through hard work and stubbornness he earned a respectable place as a war advisor to a Marquis. But Reyes is in possession of an ever travelling mind, and when rumours from the New World reached his ears, speaking of dark cults and heathen rituals, he set his sights on those mysterious new shores. If there was ancient magic and forbidden knowledge there, it would be his.
aliases.translation: 丹尼尔·雷耶斯出身士兵世家，却决心跳出家族传统。尽管父亲为他铺下了从军之路，他却选择钻研战略与战斗战术，凭借勤奋和固执，赢得了侯爵麾下一名受人尊敬的军事顾问之职。但雷耶斯的心思总在远方；新大陆有关黑暗邪教与异教仪式的传闻传入他耳中后，他便将目光投向那片神秘的新海岸。若那里真有古老魔法与禁忌知识，它们终将归他所有。

aliases.source: Il padre di Julio fu ucciso nel tentativo di difendere sua madre partoriente. I suoi genitori erano in viaggio verso la tua città quando furono attaccati dai banditi. Sua madre fuggì, ferita e prossima al parto. Crollò e morì poco lontano dalle porte della città, ma fortunatamente una giovane coppia salvò Julio dal grembo della genitrice morente, allevandolo come un figlio. Suo padre adottivo gestiva la biblioteca di tuo padre e Julio crebbe circondato da libri e opuscoli. In un ambiente come questo, fu naturale per lui dedicarsi alle scienze. Eppure qualcosa lo agitava interiormente, spingendolo a cercare avventure.
aliases.english_source: Julio's father was killed defending his birthing mother. His parents had been travelling to your town when they were attacked by bandits. His mother escaped, wounded and breaking water. She collapsed and died close to the city gates, but luckily a young couple rescued Julio from his dying mother's womb and raised the child as their own. Because his adoptive father was the keeper of your father's library, Julio grew up surrounded by books and pamphlets alike. It was natural for him to turn to the sciences in that environment. Yet something stirred in him, driving him to seek adventure.
aliases.translation: 胡里奥的父亲为保护临盆的母亲而丧命。当时父母正前往你的城镇，途中遭遇强盗袭击。母亲带伤逃脱，羊水也已破裂。她倒在城门附近，最终不幸身亡；所幸一对年轻夫妇从她弥留之际的腹中救出了胡里奥，并把他当作亲生孩子抚养。养父是你父亲图书馆的看守，因此胡里奥从小便被书籍和小册子包围。在那样的环境里，他自然而然地投身科学。可他心中仍有某种东西在涌动，驱使他去寻求冒险。

aliases.source: Mercedes nacque nel 1496 da genitori ignoti. Fu trovata sui gradini di un convento, dove fu accolta e accudita. Mano a mano che cresceva, poneva alle suore problemi sempre maggiori, poiché preferiva dedicarsi a studi che mettevano in discussione la loro fede. Per evitare di essere additata come strega, fuggi all'età di tredici anni e visse una vita appartata fino al momento in cui si unì alla tua spedizione. La sua conoscenza della mitologia è straordinaria e, in un mondo che ne è ricchissimo, rappresenta una risorsa estremamente preziosa.
aliases.english_source: Mercedes was born in 1496 to unknown parents. She was found on the steps at a convent where she was taken in and cared for. Growing up, she proved extremely difficult for the nuns, preferring to study fields that challenged their faith. In fear of being branded a witch, she ran away at age 13 and lived a secluded life up until joining your expedition. Her insights into mythology are unrivaled, and facing a world with a rich mythology in its own right, she is an invaluable asset.
aliases.translation: 梅赛德斯于1496年出生，亲生父母不详。她在修道院的台阶上被人发现，后来被收留照料。长大后，她让修女们头疼不已，因为她偏爱研究那些挑战她们信仰的领域。她害怕被打成女巫，13岁时便逃了出去，此后一直过着隐居生活，直到加入你的远征队。她对神话的见解无人能及；面对这个本身就拥有丰富神话的世界，她是不可多得的助力。

aliases.source: Zárraga è un uomo assetato di conoscenza, dal comportamento spietato. Non vi è libro o pergamena cui non riesca ad avere accesso, poiché chiunque si metta sulla sua strada è trascinato nell'infamia fino all'orlo della bancarotta. Il fine giustifica sempre i mezzi per Carlos Zárraga, e le tradizioni e i segreti del Nuovo Mondo gli SARANNO rivelati, anche a costo di torturare qualunque anima incontri.
aliases.english_source: Zárraga is a hunter of knowledge, ruthless in his approach. No books or scrolls are unavailable to him, as any who tries to keep them from him is dragged through defamation to the verge of bankruptcy. The means always justify the end for Carlos Zárraga, and the lore and secrets of the new world WILL be revealed to him, even if it means torturing every soul he finds.
aliases.translation: 萨拉加是个追逐知识的猎人，手段冷酷。没有书籍或卷轴能逃过他的手掌心：凡是试图阻拦他的人，都会遭他诽谤中伤，直至濒临破产。对卡洛斯·萨拉加而言，结果总能证明手段正当；新大陆的传说与秘密终将被他揭开，哪怕这意味着要折磨他遇到的每一个人。

aliases.source: La bella Bonita è figlia di un cacciatore del re. Il suo fascino radioso e la sua incredibile bellezza la rendevano la fanciulla più attraente della corte, fino al punto che il padre dovette assoldare delle guardie per tenere lontani i numerosi pretendenti. La bellezza per cui la maggior parte delle donne ucciderebbero era comunque una maledizione per Bonita, poiché ella ambiva a essere rispettata e ammirata più per i suoi meriti che per il suo aspetto. Questo desiderio alla fine la indusse a fuggire e a unirsi alla tua spedizione.
aliases.english_source: Beautiful Bonita was the daughter of a royal huntsman to the King. Her radiant charms and her incredible beauty made her the most attractive maiden in the court, to the extent that her father was forced to hire guards to keep the suitors away. What most women would kill to have was a curse to Bonita, however, as she longed to be respected and admired for her achievements rather than her looks. This desire finally drove her to run away and join your expedition.
aliases.translation: 美丽的博妮塔是国王麾下一名王室猎官的女儿。她光彩照人的魅力与惊人美貌使她成为宫廷中最迷人的少女，以至于父亲不得不雇卫兵赶走求婚者。然而，别的女人梦寐以求的一切，对博妮塔而言却是诅咒：她渴望凭借自己的成就获得尊重与赞赏，而非美貌。最终，这份渴望促使她离家出走，加入你的远征队。

aliases.source: Oltre all'anno di nascita, non si sa molto del passato di Raúl Carrillo. Per anni fu un ricercato, accusato di bracconaggio e di altre attività illecite. In che modo riuscì a eludere la giustizia per tanto tempo è ignoto, ma il fatto che sia ancora in libertà è una testimonianza delle sue capacità. È di carattere sanguigno e facile all'ira, ma nella giungla la sua pazienza non conosce limiti. Può rimanere immobile per ore, pronto a scattare come un fulmine.
aliases.english_source: Besides the year of his birth, not much is known about the past of Raúl Carrillo. For years, he was a wanted man, accused of poaching and other inappropriate activities. How he managed to escape the law for so long is unknown, but his continued freedom is a testament to his talents. He is ill-tempered and quick to anger, but in the jungles his patience knows no bounds. For hours on end he can be still, ready to pounce at the blink of an eye.
aliases.translation: 除了出生年份，人们对劳尔·卡里略的过去知之甚少。多年来他一直是通缉犯，被指控偷猎及从事其他不法勾当。他如何能长期逃脱法律制裁，无人知晓；但他至今仍逍遥法外，足以证明他的本事。他脾气暴躁，动辄发怒，可在丛林里却耐心无穷。几个小时一动不动地潜伏对他而言不在话下，只等眨眼间扑向猎物。

aliases.source: Nata nel 1489, crebbe in città nella casa di un fabbricante di frecce. La sua conoscenza degli archi compete con quella di qualunque esperto e la sua destrezza nel maneggiarli va persin oltre, ma si è dimostrata altrettanto abile con il fucile. Addestratasi con la guardia cittadina per diversi anni, arrivò a surclassare i suoi superiori, prendendone il posto nell'addestramento degli allievi. Sebbene non sia di carattere propriamente umile, è ben consapevole dei propri limiti e ha una personalità nel complesso piacevole, che ne fa un'eccellente compagna.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1489, she grew up in the city under the roof of a fletcher. Her knowledge of bows rivals any expert, and her ability to handle them exceeds even that, but she's proven to be equally handy with an arquebus. She trained with the city guard for several years, before eventually surpassing her superiors, taking over their duties in teaching her fellow students. Although not exactly humble, she is still well aware of her limitations and has an overall pleasant personality, making her a great companion.
aliases.translation: 她生于1489年，在一名制弓匠家中长大。她对弓的了解足以媲美任何专家，运用弓的本领更是有过之而无不及；不过，她使用火绳枪也同样得心应手。她曾在城镇卫队训练多年，后来逐渐超越上级，接过了教导同窗的职责。她虽算不上谦逊，却很清楚自己的局限，性格总体也十分讨喜，是个很好的伙伴。

aliases.source: Rafael conduceva una vita felice in Spagna come cacciatore, fino al momento in cui si rovinò da solo. Accecato da un'assurda gelosia e completamente ubriaco, una notte uccise l'adorata moglie, sospettandola di adulterio. Fu arrestato e processato per omicidio, giudicato colpevole e condannato a morte. All'ultimo momento, fu offerta a Rafael la grazia se avesse acconsentito di farsi inviare nel Nuovo Mondo al servizio della Corona Spagnola per esplorare il continente.
aliases.english_source: Rafael had a good life as a hunter in Spain, until he messed it all up. Blind with baseless jealousy and drunk out of his mind, he murdered his loving wife one night on suspicion of adultery. He was caught and tried for murder, found guilty and sentenced to death. At the last possible moment, Rafael was offered a chance of pardon if he agreed to be sent to the New World and serve the Spanish Crown on expeditions to the mainland.
aliases.translation: 拉斐尔曾在西班牙过着不错的猎人生活，直到他亲手毁掉了一切。他被毫无根据的嫉妒冲昏头脑，又醉得不省人事，一夜之间竟因怀疑妻子通奸而杀死了深爱他的妻子。他被捕并以谋杀罪受审，最终被判有罪、处以死刑。在行刑前的最后关头，拉斐尔得到了一次赦免机会：只要他愿意被送往新大陆，为西班牙王室效力，参加前往美洲大陆的远征。

aliases.source: Alejandro era figlio di un visconte la cui famiglia cadde in disgrazia quando questi entrò in conflitto con un cardinale e divenne bersaglio dell'Inquisizione. La natura e l'origine della disputa che causò la rovina di Pintado sono torbide e misteriose e se Alejandro sa qualcosa, non ha intenzione di raccontarlo. Si è arruolato nella tua compagnia per restaurare l'onore del suo nome e finora si è dimostrato molto in gamba.
aliases.english_source: Alejandro was the son of a Vizconde whose house fell into disgrace and destitution when he ran afoul of a cardinal and became a target of the Inquisition. The nature and origin of the dispute that felled Pintado are murky and mysterious, and if Alejandro knows anything, he isn't willing to share it. He joined your hermandad hoping to restore honour to his name, and so far he's been doing quite well.
aliases.translation: 亚历杭德罗是子爵之子。父亲得罪了一位红衣主教，成为宗教裁判所的目标后，家族便蒙羞落魄。导致平塔多家族衰败的争端究竟缘何而起、始于何处，至今仍扑朔迷离；即便亚历杭德罗知道些什么，他也不愿透露。他加入你的兄弟会，希望恢复家族名誉，迄今进展颇为顺利。

aliases.source: Fin dagli inizi, la vita è stata dura con Gabriela. Lasciata sola a provvedere a sé stessa all'età di dodici anni, visse di prostituzione ed elemosina. Dopo che fu sul punto di morire in seguito a un disperato aborto di fortuna, la sua sorte finalmente cambiò grazie a un anziano boscaiolo, che la prese con sé e le insegnò a cacciare gli animali e conciare le pelli. Recuperò la stima in sé stessa conducendo per diversi anni una vita rispettabile, quindi si unì all'equipaggio di una nave diretta a Hispaniola, dove la incontrasti mentre cacciava nelle foreste a nord-est di Santo Domingo.
aliases.english_source: Life was not good to Gabriela in the early years of her life. Thrown out of her family's house to fend for herself at the age of 12, she resorted to prostitution and begging to feed herself. After she nearly died following a desperate makeshift abortion, her luck finally changed when she was taken in by a lonely old woodsman who taught her hunting and tanning. Her sense of self-worth finally restored after several years of maintaining a respectable living, she joined the crew of a ship to Hispaniola, where you met her as a hunter in the forests northeast of Santo Domingo.
aliases.translation: 加夫列拉早年的生活并不顺遂。12岁时，她被家人赶出家门，只能独自谋生，于是靠卖淫和乞讨糊口。一次走投无路的土法堕胎几乎要了她的命；此后她的运气终于有所好转，一位孤独的老樵夫收留了她，并教她狩猎与制革。几年间，她靠正当营生重拾自尊，随后成为一艘开往伊斯帕尼奥拉岛的船只上的船员。你是在圣多明各东北方的森林里遇见她的，当时她正是一名猎人。

aliases.source: Sin da quando era bambino, Montego ebbe sempre un forte senso del dovere civico e un ardente desiderio di avventure e gloria, ma non fu mai particolarmente abile nel combattimento né amava uccidere le persone. Quando si arruolò nella tua compagnia, intraprese lo studio delle mappe e delle tecniche di orientamento e ben presto divenne il miglior esploratore di cui tu potessi disporre. Finché Montego è con te, sai che non vi perderete mai.
aliases.english_source: Ever since he was a child, Montego always had a strong sense of civic duty and a powerful desire to find adventure and be a hero, but he was never very good at combat or very fond of killing people. When he joined your hermandad, he took up the study of maps and orienteering and quickly became the best scout in your brotherhood. As long as Montego is with you, you know that you will never get lost.
aliases.translation: 蒙特戈从小就有强烈的公共责任感，满心渴望冒险、成为英雄；可他既不擅长战斗，也不喜欢杀人。加入你的兄弟会后，他开始学习地图绘制与野外寻路，很快便成了兄弟会里最出色的斥候。只要蒙特戈跟着你，你就不用担心迷路。

aliases.source: Francisco è un giovane snello, dai lineamenti delicati e dal fascino malizioso. Sebbene quando salpasti per il Nuovo Mondo si era unito alla tua compagnia solo da poco tempo, non vedeva l'ora di partecipare alla spedizione. Resistenza e agilità compensano la sua mancanza di forza fisica, e i suoi giochi acrobatici sono particolarmente apprezzati la sera, attorno ai fuochi dell'accampamento.
aliases.english_source: Francisco is a short and slender young man with delicate features and a rogueish charm. Though he had only recently joined your hermandad by the time you left for the New World, he was eager to join your expedition. What he lacks in strength, he more than makes up for in endurance and agility, and his acrobatic tricks are particularly popular in the evening around the campfires.
aliases.translation: 弗朗西斯科是个身材矮小纤瘦的年轻人，五官秀气，带着几分浪荡子的魅力。你启程前往新大陆时，他才刚加入你的兄弟会，却已迫不及待想参加远征。他力量不足之处，耐力与敏捷足以弥补；尤其是在营火旁的夜晚，他表演的杂技总是大受欢迎。

aliases.source: Figlia di un contadino, Daniela si sposò con un ricco mercante relativamente tardi, all'età di quindici anni. La coppia viaggiò molto e Daniela imparò presto a sopravvivere in vari tipi di terreni e in condizioni climatiche differenti. Il suo talento naturale nell'orientamento fu di grande utilità al marito e per diversi anni gli affari andarono bene. Quando Daniela aveva circa venticinque anni, suo marito fu tragicamente ucciso da un socio in affari e derubato di tutti i suoi averi. Vedova e indigente, Daniela fu trovata e accolta da un membro della tua compagnia, al servizio della quale poté sfruttare al meglio le proprie abilità.
aliases.english_source: Daniela was a farmer's daughter who married a wealthy merchant relatively late, at the age of 15. The couple travelled a lot, and Daniela quickly learned how to survive on the road, in many types of terrain and weather. Her natural talent for path finding served her husband well, and for several years, business was good. When Daniela was in her mid-20s, tragedy struck as her husband was murdered by a business partner and robbed of all his possessions. Left a destitute widow, Daniela was found and taken in by a member of your hermandad, where she put her skills to good use.
aliases.translation: 丹妮埃拉是农夫的女儿，15岁时才嫁给一位富商，在当时已算相当晚婚。夫妻二人四处奔走，丹妮埃拉很快学会了如何在旅途中生存，适应各种地形与天气。她天生擅长辨路，令丈夫受益匪浅，生意也顺遂了好几年。丹妮埃拉二十多岁时遭逢变故：丈夫被生意伙伴杀害，财物也被洗劫一空。她沦为一贫如洗的寡妇，后来被你兄弟会的一名成员发现并收留，总算得以施展所长。

aliases.source: Nata nel 1498, Raina è una donna imperturbabile e professionale che si è arruolata molto giovane nella tua compagnia nella speranza di trovare un posto in cui sentirsi parte di qualcosa. Preferisce l'arguzia e l'intelligenza allo scontro e all'uso della forza, ed è una vera miniera di trucchi e conoscenze di sopravvivenza in mezzo alla natura.
aliases.english_source: Born in 1498, Raina is a stoic and professional-minded woman who joined your hermandad at an early age hoping to find a place where she could feel like she belonged. She prefers subtlety and cleverness over force and confrontation, and she possesses a seemingly endless font of tricks and knowledge of wilderness survival.
aliases.translation: 蕾娜生于1498年，是个沉着而严谨的女人。她很早便加入你的兄弟会，希望找到一个真正有归属感的地方。比起强攻和正面冲突，她更偏爱隐秘行动与机敏应对；她似乎有用不完的奇招，对野外生存也颇有心得。

aliases.source: Federico è la persona più anziana della tua spedizione e ha alle spalle un'esperienza pluriennale di servizio attivo come soldato, ma è sempre stato troppo ribelle per avanzare di rango. Quando si offrì di partecipare alla tua spedizione, sospettasti che proprio le qualità che lo rendevano un soldato mediocre, ovvero l'indipendenza e la completa mancanza di senso dell'onore, ne avrebbero fatto un eccellente esploratore, e infatti da allora Federico si è dimostrato pieno di risorse ed efficace nel suo nuovo ruolo.
aliases.english_source: The oldest person in your expedition, Federico has many years of active service experience as a soldier, but has always been too insubordinate to advance beyond a basic rank. When he offered to join your expedition, you suspected that the very qualities that made him a poor soldier - his independence and his utter lack of honour - would make him an excellent scout, and indeed Federico has since proven himself to be highly resourceful and effective in his new role.
aliases.translation: 费德里科是你这支远征队中年纪最大的人。他有多年现役士兵经验，却总因桀骜不驯而无法晋升到基础军阶以上。当他提出加入远征队时，你猜想，正是那些令他成为差劲士兵的特质——独立自主、毫无荣誉感——会让他成为出色的斥候。事实证明，你的判断没错：费德里科在新职位上既机灵又能干。

aliases.source: Fiera e indipendente, sin dall'inizio della spedizione Ana ha assunto tra i tuoi uomini il soprannome di "Pantera". Quando è in servizio, si segnala per la capacità di muoversi senza essere notata su qualsiasi tipo di terreno, come un'ombra che non lascia alcun segno su ciò che la circonda. Inutile dirlo, questo la rende un eccellente esploratore. Nelle ore libere, invece, si distingue per i numerosi amanti e perché non fa nulla per dissimulare la propria licenziosità. Naturalmente, tra i soldati serpeggia ogni tipo di pettegolezzo, gelosia e disprezzo, ma ad Anita sembra non importare affatto.
aliases.english_source: Fierce and independent Ana picked up the nickname "Pantera" among the troops early in the expedition. When on duty, she is remarkable for her ability to move unnoticed through any terrain, like a shadow that leaves no mark upon its surroundings. Needless to say, this makes her an excellent scout. Off duty, she is remarkable for having several lovers and not even attempting to conceal her conduct. Naturally, this gives rise to all sorts of gossipping, jealousy, and contempt among the troops, but Anita herself seems perfectly disinterested in all this.
aliases.translation: 安娜骁勇而独立，远征初期便在军中得了“黑豹”的绰号。执行任务时，她能在任何地形中悄无声息地穿行，仿佛一道不留痕迹的影子；毫无疑问，这使她成为一名出色的斥候。休息时，她有好几位情人，而且从不试图掩饰自己的风流行径。这自然引来军中各色流言、嫉妒与鄙夷，但安娜本人似乎对此毫不在意。

aliases.source: La figlia di Andres de Yruenes che faceva parte dell'equipaggio di Colombo. La madre di Isabella era una donna taino e, da figlia di due mondi diversi, Isabela ha faticato a trovare il proprio posto nella società. Nonostante le difficoltà nel guadagnarsi la fiducia dei membri delle tribù di sua madre e il trattamento spesso terribile che le hanno riservato i coloni di Santo Domingo, Isabela ha ostinatamente mantenuto a una visione positiva della vita. Avendo visto molti dei lati peggiori delle persone, è tutt'altro che ingenua, ma è una donna stoicamente gentile e di mentalità aperta che si batte per la pace e la riconciliazione di entrambi i suoi due popoli.
aliases.english_source: The daughter of Andres de Yruenes, who was a part of Columbus' crew. Isabela's mother was a Taíno woman, and as a child of two worlds, Isabela has never found it easy to fit in. Despite her difficulties in gaining the trust of her mother's tribesmen, and the often terrible treatment she sustained from the colonists in Santo Domingo, Isabela has stubbornly held on to a positive outlook on life. She is far from naive, having seen many of the worst sides of people, but she is a stoically polite and open-minded woman who fights for peace and reconciliation for both her peoples.
aliases.translation: 哥伦布船员之一安德烈斯·德·尤鲁埃内斯之女。伊莎贝拉的母亲是一位泰诺人。作为两个世界的孩子，伊莎贝拉始终难以融入其中。尽管她难以取得母亲族人的信任，也常遭圣多明各殖民者恶劣对待，她仍顽强地保持着乐观的人生态度。她绝非天真无知，早已见识过人性最恶劣的一面；但她是一位沉着、礼貌、思想开放的女性，为两个族群的和平与和解而奋斗。

aliases.source: Esteban è arrivato a Hispaniola all'età di 23 anni. È stato reclutato nell'esercito e per due anni ha prestato servizio agli ordini di Noriega, seppur con riluttanza. Quando ne ha avuto abbastanza ha disertato, andando a vivere da solo nella giungla per quasi dieci anni. Infine si è unito a una banda di altri disertori comandata segretamente da Leandra Vizcaino: in poco tempo ne ha assunto il comando e ha guadagnato la lealtà dei suoi uomini. Temendo una guerra per il potere, Leandra ha teso un'imboscata alle sue truppe, dopo aver mandato Esteban a proporre un'alleanza alla tribù dei Caribe. A questo punto vi siete incontrati nuovamente, lo hai battuto ancora una volta e lo hai convinto a passare dalla tua parte.
aliases.english_source: Esteban came to Hispaniola at the age of 23. He was drafted into the army and served uneasily under Capitán Noriega for two years. When he was fed up, he deserted and lived by himself in the jungle for almost a decade. Eventually he joined a band of fellow deserters under the secret command of Leandra Vizcaino, but he soon took charge of the troops, and they became far more loyal to him. Fearing a power-struggle, Leandra ambushed his troops, driving Esteban to seek an alliance with the savage Caribs. There, you found him again, defeated him one last time, and convinced him to join you.
aliases.translation: 埃斯特班23岁时来到了伊斯帕尼奥拉岛。他被征召入伍，在诺列加上尉麾下服役了两年，日子并不好过。终于忍无可忍后，他当了逃兵，独自在丛林中生活了近十年。后来，他加入了一伙同样当过逃兵的人；这伙人暗中听命于莱安德拉·维斯卡伊诺。但不久后，他便接管了这支队伍，众人也对他忠心了许多。莱安德拉担心权力之争，于是伏击了他的部队，逼得埃斯特班转而寻求与野蛮的加勒比人结盟。你在那里再次找到他，最后一次击败了他，并说服他加入你的队伍。

aliases.source: Il mercenario ungherese è un uomo dalla corporatura robusta, che appare ancora più imponente nell'armatura nera rattoppata. Si è addestrato nell'Armata nera ungherese e ha combattuto contro i Turchi e contro contadini in rivolta. Dopo lo scioglimento del Fekete sereg, la sua compagnia si divise e lui viaggiò in Italia per combattere come mercenario. È venuto nel Nuovo Mondo in cerca del suo amico, Tamás Szász.
aliases.english_source: The Hungarian mercenary is a powerfully built man who looks particularly imposing in his black piecemeal armour. He was trained in Hungary's Black Army and fought against the Turks as well as a peasant rebellion. After the dissolution of the Fekete sereg, his company struck out on their own and he travelled to Italy to fight as a mercenary. Now he has come to the New World searching for his old friend, Tamás Szász.
aliases.translation: 这名匈牙利雇佣兵身材魁梧，穿着一身黑色拼凑护甲，显得格外威风。他曾在匈牙利黑军受训，也曾与土耳其人作战，并镇压过一场农民叛乱。黑军解散后，他所在的佣兵队自立门户；他则前往意大利，以雇佣兵身份作战。如今，他来到新大陆，寻找旧友塔马什·萨斯。

aliases.source: La splendida, fiera e coraggiosa Citlalli era ufficiosamente a capo di un piccolo gruppo di donne che partecipò alla difesa della città azteca di Tenochtitlán. Quando il sommo sacerdote Momoztli si invaghì di lei, lo rifiutò, divenendo così bersaglio della sua collera. Privata del diritto di servire la sua città e per il bene delle sue sorelle, scelse l'esilio. Le altre guerriere la seguirono. Divenuta ufficialmente condottiera, utilizzò tattiche avanzate e astute per sconfiggere i suoi potenti nemici e guidare la sua tribù di guerriere verso la prosperità.
aliases.english_source: Proud, fierce, and gorgeous Citlalli was the unofficial leader of a small group of women who participated in the defence of the Aztec city of Tenochtitlan. When the high priest Momoztli cast his affections on her, she rejected him and suffered his wrath in return. Denied the right to serve her city, and faced with losing her sisters, she chose exile and her sisters followed her. Now officially the War Chief of the warrior women, she used advanced and cunning tactics to lead her new tribe to prosperity despite her powerful enemies.
aliases.translation: 自豪、勇猛而美丽的西特拉利曾是一个小群体中非正式的领袖。这群女性曾参与阿兹特克人特诺奇蒂特兰城的防御。大祭司莫莫兹特利倾心于她时，她拒绝了他，随即遭到了他的怒火报复。她被剥夺了为城邦效力的权利，又面临失去姐妹们的境地，于是选择流亡；她的姐妹们也追随她而去。如今，她正式成为女战士们的战酋，凭借高超而狡黠的战术，带领新部族走向兴盛，尽管强敌环伺。

aliases.source: Ruvido e sardonico, Coyotl era un grande guerriero aquila dell'Impero azteco. Poi si attirò le ire dell'aristocrazia di Tenochtitlán, rifiutandosi di eseguire gli ordini dei nobili perché scontento dell'apatia da essi dimostrata nei confronti delle sofferenze patite dal popolo. Così, perse il comando dei suoi guerrieri e fu costretto ad abbandonare la città di Texcoco, dove era di stanza. A quel punto, si unì alla tua spedizione.
aliases.english_source: The grizzled and sardonic Coyotl was a distinguished Eagle Warrior of the Aztec until he angered the nobles of Tenochtitlan. Unhappy with their apathy towards the suffering of the commoners, he took matters into his own hands and went against their explicit orders. In doing so, he lost command of his warriors and was forced to leave the city of Texcoco where he had been stationed. Instead, he joined your expedition.
aliases.translation: 饱经风霜、言辞尖刻的科约特尔曾是阿兹特克人中杰出的鹰战士，直到他惹恼了特诺奇蒂特兰的贵族。他不满他们对平民苦难漠不关心，便亲自采取行动，违抗了他们的明确命令。此举让他失去了对麾下战士的指挥权，也被迫离开驻扎之地特斯科科城。后来，他加入了你的远征队。

aliases.source: Necalli significa "battaglia" nella lingua dei nativi. Fedele al suo nome, è senza dubbio uno dei migliori guerrieri di tutte le tribù totonache. Necalli è un guerriero nato ed è stato cresciuto per proteggere il suo villaggio e la sua gente dalla cupidigia degli Aztechi. Quando gli è arrivata la voce della tua campagna contro gli Aztechi, non ci ha pensato due volte ed è venuto a cercarti.
aliases.english_source: Necalli means "battle" in the language of the natives, and true to his name, he is without a doubt one of the finest warriors of any of the Totonac tribes. Necalli has been a warrior from the day he was born, raised to protect the village and his fellow tribesmen from the greed of the Aztec. When the tales of your campaign against the Aztecs spread to his home, he was quick to leave his village and seek you out.
aliases.translation: 内卡利在原住民语言中意为"战斗"。他确实名副其实，毫无疑问是托托纳克部族中最出色的战士之一。内卡利自出生起便是战士，从小被培养着保护村庄和族人免受阿兹特克人的贪欲侵害。当你对抗阿兹特克人的战事传到他家乡后，他很快便离开村庄，前来寻找你。

aliases.source: La tua amorevole moglie, che hai sposato in un piccolo villaggio di benestanti pescatori di perle, capeggiati da suo padre. Il carattere di Tayanna è quello di chi ha condotto un'esistenza privilegiata, sicura e senza preoccupazioni, ma il suo ottimismo e il suo carisma la fanno risplendere come un faro nel mezzo della spedizione.
aliases.english_source: Your loving wife, who you married in a small village where her father ruled a wealthy tribe of pearl fishers. Tayanna exhibits many traits often found in those who have been priviledged with a safe and largely care-free existence, and her optimism and charisma makes her light up like a beacon in your expedition.
aliases.translation: 你深爱的妻子。你们在一个小村庄结了婚，她的父亲统治着一个富庶的采珠人部族。塔娅娜身上有许多特质，常见于那些有幸过着安全、无忧生活的人；她乐观开朗，魅力十足，在你的远征队中如灯塔般耀眼。

aliases.source: Il tuo affettuoso marito, che hai sposato in un piccolo villaggio di benestanti pescatori di perle, capeggiati da suo padre. Cacama è di indole dolce e gentile, a differenza della maggior parte degli uomini che hai avuto. È sempre ottimista e affronta tutti i problemi con un'energia e un entusiasmo che mettono quasi in ombra tutti gli altri membri della spedizione.
aliases.english_source: Your loving husband, who you married in a small village where his father ruled a wealthy tribe of pearl fishers. Cacama has a tender and considerate disposition, in stark contrast to most of the men in your life. He is consistently open-minded and addresses every problem with an energy and enthusiasm that puts everyone else in your expedition to shame.
aliases.translation: 你深爱的丈夫。你们是在一个小村庄成婚的，他的父亲统治着一个富庶的采珠人部族。卡卡马性情温柔体贴，与你生命中的大多数男人截然不同。他始终思想开放，面对任何问题都充满干劲和热情，让远征队里的其他人相形见绌。

aliases.source: Miguel Sicart è uno dei pochi sopravvissuti alla spedizione di Felipe Gutiérrez che hai incontrato sul continente. Lo hai trovato in una piccola capanna che si era costruito da sé e, dopo una breve avventura con una paella tossica a base di rane, lo hai convinto a unirsi alla tua spedizione. Lui continua fastidiosamente a eludere tutte le domande su Gutiérrez, tuttavia approfitta di ogni occasione per definire il tuo predecessore un folle.
aliases.english_source: Miguel Sicart is one of the few survivors of Felipe Gutiérrez's expedition that you've encountered on the mainland. You found him in a small hut that he'd built himself, and after a little adventure with a poisonous frog paella, you convinced him to join your expedition. Annoyingly he continues to evade all questions about Gutiérrez, but wastes no opportunity to call your predecessor a fool.
aliases.translation: 米格尔·西卡特是你在美洲大陆遇到的、费利佩·古铁雷斯远征队少数幸存者之一。你在一间他亲手搭建的小屋里找到了他。经历了一场毒蛙肉西班牙烩饭的小小冒险后，你说服他加入了你的远征队。令人恼火的是，他仍然回避所有关于古铁雷斯的问题，却总能抓住机会骂你的前任是个蠢货。

aliases.source: Patli è un po' un mistero per te.
